finalText:
The build's clean — exit 0, 0 errors.

Two real bugs, both from the bundler bump:
1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. It crashed on every build.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated an unset backoff flag as invalid. The new config loader leaves it `undefined` instead of `false`, so it threw. Now `undefined` is treated as disabled, same as before.

The rest of the noise — `DEP0142`, `DEP0198`, `punycode`, etc. — is just deprecation chatter from the bump, harmless.
